name: Nek'rosh's Gambit
summary: At Menethil Harbor, Captain Stoutfist fears a Dragonmaw siege. Chieftain Nek'rosh has built engines to bombard the vulnerable port town, while fighting at Dun Algaz cuts off reinforcements. You are sent into the marshes to destroy the catapults before the attack begins.

sections.title: A Looming Siege
sections.body: Dwarven scouts uncovered Nek'rosh's plan as Alliance fighters clashed with Dragonmaw raiders. The chieftain has overseen the building of full-scale siege catapults in the Wetlands encampments. He means to bring the engines to Menethil Harbor and batter its fortress walls, threatening the Alliance's main shipping hub on the western coast.

sections.title: Cut Off at Dun Algaz
sections.body: Fighting and greenskin activity have congested the mountain passes at Dun Algaz, isolating the lowlands from Ironforge's main garrisons. Without aid from Khaz Modan, Captain Stoutfist cannot spare troops to guard the harbor's perimeter. Menethil's survival depends on sabotaging the catapults before they can be brought against the town.

sections.title: Fire in the Encampment
sections.body: Scouts carry Dwarven Tinder into the heart of the Dragonmaw encampment. They must set the timber catapults ablaze and destroy them, stripping Nek'rosh of his artillery and denying his warriors the firepower to break Menethil's defenses. The engines must be ruined before the warlord himself can be confronted.

faq.answer: Nek'rosh is the ruthless chieftain leading the remnants of the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. He is directing a campaign to besiege Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why is Menethil Harbor in such danger?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor depends on naval trade and lies apart from Ironforge. Fighting congests the passes at Dun Algaz, blocking reinforcements by land and leaving the town unable to withstand a concentrated siege.

faq.q: What is the goal of this mission?
faq.answer: You carry Dwarven Tinder into the Dragonmaw encampment to set their siege catapults ablaze and destroy them before they can be brought against Menethil Harbor.
Captain Stoutfist gives the orders. The dwarf officer coordinates the harbor's local defense and the campaign against the Dragonmaw.

faq.q: What follows the destruction of the catapults?
faq.answer: After the catapults are destroyed, the threat must be ended by tracking down and executing Chieftain Nek'rosh himself.

faq.q: Why can't Ironforge send troops to help Menethil?
faq.answer: The road from Loch Modan to the Wetlands runs through Dun Algaz. Hostile forces contest and ambush the pass, cutting off reliable ground travel.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you know Menethil Harbor is your people's gateway to the western sea. Losing it to Dragonmaw siege weapons would cripple Ironforge's maritime connections.
With fighting locking down Dun Algaz, the Alliance must depend on brave volunteers to disrupt the Dragonmaw war machine.
As a warrior, you rely on aggressive frontline tactics and brutal hand-to-hand fighting to storm an entrenched enemy camp and destroy its heavy siege artillery.
